answer: Each identity spends one carrier walking one route per epoch. Registration locks 100 units for 8 epochs and issues one swab kit per identity. In one 20-minute window the carrier visits three stops: a cedar post loading the swab with resin, a walnut press whose die stamps the kit seal, and a sparrow aviary where dust settles on it. Staff test resin and dust and match the stamp; one kit cannot meet the window for two identities, stops sitting 2 km apart. An honest carrier walks once; 1,000 fakes need 1,000 kits, 1,000 carriers, 100,000 locked — a shared kit is itself publishable fraud proof.
